items.title: Alfred Williams Interview, 1960-04-30
items.q: Went up on the boat with Piran. Made a trip with Piran in 34 on the JS.

ctx.x: The Celestan's part of them or something? That's right, that's right. And how long were you with Ridgely?

I was Ridgely about a year. See, 28. Then I went to La Vida in 29. There you see. Stayed in La Vida's, 29. 30. 31. 32. I went to Piran. I went to Piran from 32 to 35. Went up on the boat with Piran. Made a trip with Piran in 34 on the JS.
Did you go all the way up to St. Paul or how far?
